fixed.member: og check and og test of a game with playtests
fixed.summary: A game's type check failed with 8 errors in .og/engine/src/provider.ts and src/web/relay-rooms.ts (setTimeout, WebSocket, Event, MessageEvent and CloseEvent not found), so og test ran no playtest: the provider module, which @origingame/engine/playtest reaches, named DOM and timer globals a game's type check does not have. It now writes out the socket it needs and reaches the timer through globalThis; relayRooms and checkPlatformProvider behave as before.
